description: Artistic Denim Mills (ADM) is a vertically integrated, family-owned denim fabric manufacturer established in Karachi in 1993. Its process runs from cotton recycling through spinning, weaving, indigo and fibre dyeing, finishing and garment production, and it produces premium denim fabrics — fibre dyed, indigo rope dyed, TENCEL, stretch, recycled cotton and performance denim — for fashion brands in Europe, the United States and other markets. The company holds GOTS, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, Cradle to Cradle, GRS, RCS, BCI, WRAP, BSCI and Higg certifications.
